scenario: 面试给的是 Strava 类 App，45 分钟只够设计核心记录链路，社交互动明确划在范围外。
scenario_en: In a 45-minute Strava-style interview, there is only time for the core tracking loop; social interaction is explicitly out of scope.
q: Strava 类健身记录 App 的核心功能需求有哪些？（多选）
q_en: What are the core functional requirements for a Strava-like workout tracking app? (Choose all that apply)
options: 开始、暂停、停止并保存跑步/骑行
好友管理、点赞和评论的完整交互设计
运动中查看路线、距离和时间
查看自己和好友的已完成活动
options_en: Start, pause, stop, and save a run or ride
Fully design friend management, likes, and comments
View route, distance, and time during the workout
View your own and friends' completed activities
why: 核心功能是记录活动、运动中展示本地统计、查看历史活动；好友管理和社交互动被显式划在范围外。
why_en: The core scope covers tracking, live stats, and viewing history, while friend management and social interaction are explicitly out of scope.
optionExplanations: 活动生命周期的最小闭环，没有它整套记录功能无从谈起。
题目把好友社交互动完整设计划在范围外，深挖它会挤占核心记录功能的时间。
运动过程中的实时反馈是用户判断配速、继续锻炼的依据，必须支持。
查看历史活动是留存和分享的基础，属于核心可见范围。
optionExplanations_en: This is the minimal start-pause-stop loop for one workout — without it there is no tracking feature at all.
The prompt puts fully designing social interaction out of scope, so digging into it eats time needed for core tracking.
Live feedback during the workout is what lets an athlete judge pace, so it has to be in scope.
Viewing completed history drives retention and sharing, so it stays in core scope.

scenario: 用户常在山区、地铁等无信号处跑步，App 要全程不中断记录并实时显示本地统计。
scenario_en: Users often run in mountains or subways with no signal, so the app must keep recording throughout and still show live local stats.
q: Strava 题中关键非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which non-functional requirements matter most in the Strava design? (Choose all that apply)
options: 系统应高可用，availability 优先于 consistency
无网络的偏远地区仍要能记录活动
所有 GPS 点必须每秒同步写入服务器才算正确
运动中本地统计要准确且及时
options_en: The system should favor availability over strict consistency
The app must keep tracking in remote areas with no network
Every GPS point must sync to the server every second to count
Local stats during the workout must be accurate and timely
why: 运动记录首先要能离线、不中断，并让用户在本地看到准确数据；强制服务端每秒同步反而违背离线可用性。
why_en: Tracking must stay available offline with accurate local stats, so forcing per-second server sync would break that goal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在请求到来时仍能返回响应的能力，即使数据可能不是最新的。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Availability is a system's ability to keep responding to requests even if the data might be slightly stale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有节点或客户端在同一时间看到相同的数据版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistency means every node or client sees the same version of the data at the same time.

optionExplanations: 断网时也不能拒绝服务，availability 优先于强一致性是离线记录的前提。
山区、地铁这类信号盲区必须仍能记录，这是硬性非功能要求，不是加分项。
误解：把强制实时同步当成正确性标准，恰恰是离线优先设计要放弃的东西。
本人看到的配速、距离必须准确及时，这是运动体验的底线，不依赖服务端在线。
optionExplanations_en: The system must keep serving even without a connection, so availability wins over strict consistency for offline tracking.
Dead zones like mountains or subways must still record — that's a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
Misconception: treating forced real-time sync as the correctness bar is exactly what offline-first design gives up.
The athlete's own pace and distance must stay accurate and timely without depending on the server being online.

scenario: 要支持记录一次跑步、回放完整路线、并按好友过滤活动列表，先定最小实体集合。
scenario_en: The design must record a run, replay its full route, and filter the feed by friends, so start from the minimal entity set.
q: Strava 设计中的核心实体包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core entities should the Strava design model? (Choose all that apply)
options: User
Activity
Route/GPS coordinates
Friend relationship
options_en: User
Activity
Route or GPS coordinates
Friend relationship
why: User、Activity、Route 支撑记录与展示；Friend 关系虽不设计增删流程，但要用它过滤好友活动列表。
why_en: User, Activity, and Route support tracking and display, while the Friend relationship is still needed to filter friend feeds.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  U[User]
  A[Activity]
  R[Route points]
  F[Friend relation]
  U --> A
  A --> R
  U --> F
optionExplanations: User 是身份和权限的锚点，Activity、Friend 关系都要挂在它上面才能归属到人。
Activity 是一次跑步/骑行的记录主体，距离、时长、状态都以它为单位存储。
Route/GPS 坐标序列决定了地图上能画出真实路线并算出距离，缺了它 Activity 只是一堆数字。
好友边不需要设计增删的交互流程，但活动列表要按是不是好友筛选，所以这条边仍要建模进数据库。
optionExplanations_en: User anchors identity and ownership; Activity and Friend edges both need to point back to a user.
Activity is the unit that owns distance, duration, and state for one run or ride.
The GPS coordinate sequence is what lets the map draw a real route and compute distance — without it Activity is just abstract numbers.
You don't need to design the add/remove interaction for a friend edge, but the activity feed still filters by it, so it has to be modeled in the database.

scenario: 用户点击 Start Activity 创建一条新的跑步或骑行记录，服务端只需要知道活动类型并返回 Activity。
scenario_en: A user taps Start Activity to create a new run or ride; the server only needs the activity type and should return the new Activity.
q: 合适的 API 是什么？
q_en: Which API fits this activity creation flow?
options: 用 GET /activities 请求来创建一条新的活动记录
POST /activities，body 包含 type RUN/RIDE
用 DELETE /activities/:id 请求来创建一条新的活动记录
用 POST /friends 请求来创建一条新的活动记录
options_en: Send a GET /activities request to create a new activity record
POST /activities with body { type: RUN or RIDE }
Send a DELETE /activities/:id request to create a new activity record
Send a POST /friends request to create a new activity record
why: 创建活动是新增资源，POST /activities 最贴合语义并返回新 Activity；后续状态变化再用 PATCH。
why_en: Creating an activity is a new resource, so POST /activities fits REST semantics and returns the new Activity.
whenOtherWins: 查询活动列表或详情时才使用 GET；删除或撤销活动时才考虑 DELETE。
tradeoff: 语义正确的 POST 创建 vs 图省事复用其他 HTTP 动词

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，用于创建新资源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: POST is the HTTP verb used to create a new resource.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，用于读取资源，不修改数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GET is the HTTP verb used to read a resource without modifying it.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，用于删除资源。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DELETE is the HTTP verb used to remove a resource.

optionExplanations: GET 语义上只读取资源，把创建动作塞进 GET 会让浏览器缓存和代理误判成幂等查询，不产生新数据。
新增一条活动记录用 POST 最自然，把 type 放进请求体就能表达 RUN 还是 RIDE，之后要改状态就换 PATCH。
DELETE 语义上是移除已有资源，用它触发创建会让调用方和网关完全看不懂这是在新增什么。
/friends 路径属于好友关系资源，把创建活动的请求发到这里会让路由和资源模型对不上号。
optionExplanations_en: GET is meant for reads only; routing activity creation through it would make caches and proxies treat it as a safe query that creates nothing.
Adding a workout is a brand-new resource, so a body with type RUN or RIDE fits POST naturally — save state changes like pause for PATCH later.
DELETE means removing an existing resource, so firing it to create one leaves callers and gateways unable to tell what is actually being added.
The /friends path belongs to the friend-relationship resource, so routing activity creation there breaks the resource model and routing.

scenario: 跑步途中的暂停、恢复、完成只改 Activity 的 state 字段，手机常在弱网下发这条请求。
scenario_en: Pausing, resuming, or finishing a run only changes the Activity state field, and the phone often sends that request on a weak network.
q: 更新活动状态时，PATCH 相比 PUT 的语义优势是什么？
q_en: When updating activity state, what semantic advantage does PATCH have over PUT?
options: 使用 PATCH 更新时后端会自动保证比用 PUT 更强的一致性
PATCH 方法的语义等价于删除资源
PATCH 只更新 state 等部分字段，不必发送完整资源体
PUT 请求内容完全无法通过 HTTP 协议传输
options_en: Updating with PATCH makes the backend automatically guarantee stronger consistency than PUT
PATCH is semantically equivalent to deleting a resource
PATCH updates only part of a resource, like state, without sending the full body
A PUT request's content cannot be transported over HTTP at all
why: 暂停、恢复、完成只改 Activity 的部分字段，PATCH 只需发送变更字段，比 PUT 发送整个资源更贴切。
why_en: Pause, resume, and complete only change part of the Activity, so PATCH sending just the changed fields fits better than PUT replacing the whole resource.
tradeoff: PATCH 部分更新 vs PUT 整体替换

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，只更新资源的部分字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PATCH is the HTTP verb that updates only part of a resource.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，要求发送完整资源来替换旧值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PUT is the HTTP verb that replaces a resource by sending its full body.

optionExplanations: 误解：一致性保证由后端实现决定，跟用 PATCH 还是 PUT 这个 HTTP 动词完全无关。
误解：删除资源要用 DELETE，PATCH 表达的是局部修改，不是移除。
活动状态从 STARTED 变 PAUSED 时只有一个字段变了，PATCH 只传这一个字段，请求体更小。
误解：PUT 和 PATCH 一样能通过 HTTP 传输任意 body，这条说法本身就不成立。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: consistency guarantees come from the backend implementation, not from which HTTP verb you pick.
Misconception: deleting a resource is DELETE's job; PATCH means a partial edit, not removal.
Going from STARTED to PAUSED only changes one field, so PATCH ships just that field instead of the whole resource.
Misconception: PUT can carry a body over HTTP exactly like PATCH can — this claim is simply false.

q: 补全活动状态 API：
q_en: Complete the activity state API:
text: PATCH /activities/:activityId 可把 state 更新为 {{STARTED}}、{{PAUSED}} 或 {{COMPLETE}}；完成后活动会出现在自己和好友可见列表中。
why: 用同一个状态更新 endpoint 覆盖暂停、继续和保存，避免为分享单独设计复杂接口。
why_en: A single state-update endpoint can cover pause, resume, and completion, with completed activities becoming visible in feeds.

termDefinitions.meaning: HTTP 方法，只更新资源的部分字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PATCH is the HTTP verb that updates only part of a resource.

scenario: 用户跑步途中等红灯按了暂停 5 分钟，App 仍要显示准确的 active time。
scenario_en: A runner pauses for five minutes at a traffic light, and the app still has to show accurate active time.
q: 只用 startTimestamp 到 stopTimestamp 计算活动时间，暂停场景会出现什么问题？
q_en: What goes wrong if activity time is computed only from startTimestamp to stopTimestamp when pauses exist?
options: 暂停期间 GPS 传感器会完全停止记录任何坐标点
数据库会彻底失去分页查询的能力
用户会彻底无法创建任何好友关系
暂停期间也会被算进 elapsed time
options_en: While paused, the GPS sensor would stop recording any coordinates at all
The database would completely lose the ability to paginate
Users would become completely unable to create any friend relationship
Paused time gets counted as elapsed activity time
why: 暂停时 startTimestamp 不变，用 stop 减 start 会把休息时间也算进运动时长，导致 active time 偏大。
why_en: Because startTimestamp doesn't move during a pause, subtracting start from stop counts rest time as active time.
optionExplanations: 误解：GPS 采集和时间计算是两回事，暂停不会让传感器停止工作。
误解：分页能力由查询逻辑决定，和活动时间怎么算完全无关。
误解：好友关系建表和时间计算是两个独立模块，互不影响。
start 和 stop 之间如果没扣掉暂停区间，休息的那几分钟会被一起计入总时长，最终数字比真实运动时间偏大。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: GPS capture and elapsed-time math are unrelated — pausing doesn't stop the sensor.
Misconception: pagination is a query-layer concern that has nothing to do with how activity time is computed.
Misconception: friend-table writes are a separate module from elapsed-time math.
If the pause interval never gets subtracted between start and stop, those resting minutes get lumped into the total, so the final number reads higher than the real workout time.

scenario: 用户活动中可能多次暂停和恢复，产品还可能展示暂停区间和 active time/total time 区分。
scenario_en: A user may pause and resume several times, and the product may later show pause intervals plus active time versus total time.
q: 最合适的时间建模是什么？
q_en: What time model best supports pauses and active-time calculation?
options: 只保存一个 startTimestamp，不记录任何中间状态
状态变更加时间戳的 append-only 日志
只相信服务器收到 PATCH 请求的那个时间戳
每次暂停都直接删除已记录的历史路线点
options_en: Keep only a single startTimestamp with no intermediate state
An append-only log of state changes with timestamps
Trust only the timestamp when the server received the PATCH
Delete the already-recorded historical route points on every pause
why: 状态日志按相邻区间求和就能排除暂停时间，也天然支持未来展示暂停明细和 active/total time。
why_en: A timestamped state log lets the system sum active intervals, excluding pauses, and supports future pause analytics.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品永远不支持暂停，单 start/end timestamp 可以足够简单。
tradeoff: 状态日志的存储开销 vs 单时间戳的计算简单
optionExplanations: 只有单一 start 时间戳，等于假设活动永不暂停；一旦用户暂停恢复，这个模型没法把休息区间摘出去。
把每次 STARTED/PAUSED/RESUMED/STOPPED 都存成带时间戳的一条记录，事后按相邻区间求和就能精确排除暂停。
服务器收到请求的时间会因网络延迟、重试而偏离真实操作时刻，离线补传场景下完全不可信。
暂停不是终止，删掉已记录的路线点会让距离和地图永久丢失一段，之后没法恢复。
optionExplanations_en: A single startTimestamp assumes the activity never pauses; once a user pauses and resumes, there's no way to carve out the rest interval.
Log every STARTED/PAUSED/RESUMED/STOPPED transition with its own timestamp, then sum the adjacent intervals afterward to exclude pauses precisely.
Server receive time drifts from the real moment an action happened due to network delay and retries, especially once activities sync after being offline.
A pause isn't a stop — deleting already-recorded route points permanently loses a stretch of the map and distance that can't be recovered.

q: 用状态日志计算 active time 的正确推理顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the right reasoning order for computing active time from a state log?
steps: 求和时只累加 STARTED/RESUMED 到 PAUSED/STOPPED 之间的区间
保存 status/timestamp 事件序列
用户可能暂停，因此 start/end 直接相减不准
可扩展展示 total time 与 active time
why: 先识别暂停带来的错误，再用事件序列排除暂停区间，并自然支持更丰富的活动分析。
why_en: Recognizing pause-time error leads to a status event log that can sum active intervals and support richer analytics.
tradeoff: 事件日志的存储/复杂度 vs 单时间戳的简单但不准确
diagram:
flowchart TD
  P[Pause makes simple time wrong]
  L[Save state timestamp log]
  S[Sum active intervals]
  T[Show active and total time]
  P --> L --> S --> T

scenario: 手机每隔几秒记录经纬度，需要根据相邻坐标累加路线距离。
scenario_en: The phone records latitude and longitude every few seconds and needs to sum distances between adjacent points.
q: 计算球面两点距离的常见公式是什么？
q_en: What common formula estimates distance between two points on the Earth's surface?
options: LRU eviction
consistent hashing
Haversine formula
B-tree lookup
options_en: LRU eviction
Consistent hashing
Haversine formula
B-tree lookup
why: 相邻 GPS 坐标用 Haversine 公式算出球面距离，逐段累加就得到路线总距离。
why_en: The Haversine formula estimates the distance between adjacent GPS points, and summing those gives total route distance.
whenOtherWins: 如果移动平台已提供滤波后的 distance API，可直接用平台能力；服务端分析仍常需理解 GPS 点距离。
tradeoff: 球面距离公式的精度 vs 平台自带 API 的省事

termDefinitions.meaning: 用经纬度计算地球表面两点间大圆距离的公式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Haversine formula computes the great-circle distance between two GPS coordinates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全球定位系统，手机用它获取实时经纬度坐标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GPS is the satellite system phones use to get real-time latitude and longitude.

optionExplanations: LRU 淘汰的是缓存里最久未用的条目，跟经纬度坐标之间的距离计算不是一回事。
一致性哈希解决的是把请求/数据分布到多个节点，不涉及球面几何计算。
两点的经纬度代入 Haversine 公式，能算出球面上的大圆距离，逐段相加就是总里程。
B-tree 是数据库索引结构，用来加速按键查找，不负责算两点间的距离。
optionExplanations_en: LRU evicts the least-recently-used cache entry — that's unrelated to computing distance between two coordinates.
Consistent hashing distributes requests or data across nodes; it has nothing to do with spherical geometry.
Plugging two coordinates' latitude and longitude into the Haversine formula gives the great-circle distance, and summing segments gives total mileage.
A B-tree is a database index structure for fast key lookups, not a way to measure distance between points.

scenario: 骑行速度通常是跑步的 2-3 倍；系统对骑行约每 2 秒、跑步约每 5 秒采集一次 GPS 坐标。
scenario_en: Cycling is usually 2-3x faster than running; the system samples GPS about every 2 seconds for rides and 5 seconds for runs.
q: 骑行为什么要用比跑步更密的采样间隔？
q_en: Why should rides use a denser GPS sampling interval than runs?
options: 速度越快，同样时间间隔移动的距离越大，采样太稀会让路线和距离失真
骑行时手机内置的 GPS 硬件精度会随速度自动提升，采样间隔不用再调
两种运动无论速度快慢，理论上用同一个采样间隔效果都一样
跑步天生比骑行更耗电，所以采样间隔要调得更稀疏
options_en: At higher speed the same time gap covers more distance, so a coarse interval distorts the route and distance
The phone GPS hardware gets more accurate with speed on a ride, so the interval needs no change
Regardless of speed, both activities would theoretically work fine with the exact same sampling interval
Running drains the battery faster than riding by nature, so the interval should be sparser for running
why: 骑行更快，相同采样间隔会让路线在地图上更稀疏、距离误差更大，所以间隔要按速度缩短，而不是全局统一。
why_en: Because riding is faster, the same sampling interval leaves sparser points and larger distance error, so the interval should scale with speed.
optionExplanations: 这是本题真正的原因：速度越快，同一时间窗口跨过的距离越大，采样太稀路线会失真、距离被低估。
误解：GPS 芯片精度由硬件和信号环境决定，不会因骑行提速就变好，采样间隔仍要随速度缩短。
误解：把采样间隔和运动速度脱钩，快速运动下会漏掉更多真实路径细节。
误解：电池消耗主要看采样和上传频率，不是运动类型本身决定的固有属性。
optionExplanations_en: This is the real reason: at higher speed the same time window covers more ground, so a sparse interval distorts the route and undercounts distance.
Misconception: GPS chip accuracy is set by hardware and signal conditions, not boosted by a faster ride, so the interval still has to shrink with speed.
Misconception: decoupling sampling interval from speed means faster activities lose more real path detail between points.
Misconception: battery drain mainly tracks sampling and upload frequency, not some fixed property of the activity type itself.

scenario: 用户在山里骑行没有网络，仍要准确记录路线、距离和时间，并在本地实时查看。
scenario_en: A cyclist has no network in the mountains but still needs accurate route, distance, and time locally in real time.
q: 核心设计转折是什么？
q_en: What is the key design shift for offline workout tracking?
options: 每个 GPS 点都必须同步到服务器后才显示
无网络时禁止开始活动
让好友手机代替记录
客户端本地记录和计算，完成或恢复网络后再同步
options_en: Every GPS point must sync to the server before it can display
Block starting an activity when there is no network
Have a friend's phone record the activity instead
Record and compute locally on the client, syncing once online
why: 活动统计可以完全在设备上完成，本地记录既保证无网络仍可用，也减少了服务端流量。
why_en: The client can fully compute activity stats locally, keeping the app usable offline while cutting backend traffic.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求好友实时跟随活动，仍需周期性上传；但用户自己运动中不需要服务端实时参与。
tradeoff: 客户端可用性优先 vs 服务端实时可见性

termDefinitions.meaning: 先假设网络不可用来设计功能，再把网络当成同步的加分项。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offline-first means designing a feature to work without network first, then treating connectivity as a bonus for syncing.

optionExplanations: 把显示环节绑死在服务器确认上，一旦信号弱或掉线，界面会卡在等待状态，体验直接崩掉。
为了回避离线场景直接不让用户开始运动，等于放弃了这道题最核心的可用性需求。
好友手机不受当前用户控制，网络和续航都不可控，不能当成可信的记录设备。
统计逻辑完全放在设备端跑，无网络也能继续记录，联网后再把数据一次性同步上去。
optionExplanations_en: Tying the display to server confirmation means the UI freezes waiting the moment signal drops or the connection dies.
Refusing to start a workout without network sidesteps the offline scenario entirely, giving up the core availability requirement of this problem.
A friend's phone is outside the athlete's control — its connectivity and battery can't be trusted as a recording device.
Stats run entirely on the device, so tracking keeps working offline, and the data syncs in one batch once the network is back.

scenario: Strava 每几秒采一个 GPS 点，用户可能整场无网络，要决定记录职责放在哪一端。
scenario_en: A Strava tracker samples GPS every few seconds and the user may have no network the whole session, so decide which side owns recording.
q: 为什么 Strava 题强调客户端是系统设计的一部分？（多选）
q_en: Why does this Strava design treat the client as part of the system? (Choose all that apply)
options: 所有系统设计都必须把服务端删掉
现代手机有 GPS 传感器
手机有本地存储和可观计算能力
本地计算能在无网络时继续工作
options_en: All system designs must eliminate the backend entirely
Modern phones have GPS sensors
Phones have meaningful local storage and compute power
Local computation keeps working without network
why: 手机的传感器、存储和算力让它能承担核心记录职责；服务端仍负责持久化、同步和好友读取。
why_en: Phone sensors, storage, and compute let the client own live tracking while the backend still handles persistence and sharing.
optionExplanations: 误解：给客户端更多能力不等于要求所有系统设计都取消后端，服务端仍负责持久化和分享。
内置 GPS 让手机自己就能拿到经纬度坐标，不用靠服务端定位或转发。
本地数据库和 CPU 足够存下一整段路线并实时算距离、配速，不必事事请求服务端。
没有网络时这些本地计算照样能跑，运动统计不会因为掉线而中断。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: giving the client more responsibility does not mean every system design must remove its backend — the server still owns persistence and sharing.
Built-in GPS lets the phone get its own coordinates directly, without relying on the server for location.
Local storage and CPU are enough to hold a full route and compute distance or pace in real time without calling the server for everything.
These local computations keep running with no network, so tracking stats don't stop just because the connection drops.

q: 离线活动记录的正确流程是什么？
q_en: What is the correct flow for recording an activity offline?
steps: 网络可用且活动完成后，批量或分块上传服务端
GPS 点先进入内存 buffer 并更新本地统计
每约 10 秒把 buffer 持久化到本地存储
App 重启/恢复时先从本地存储加载未上传数据
why: 活动进行时本地 buffer 提供即时统计，周期性本地持久化降低掉电损失，之后再可靠同步服务端。
why_en: The offline flow buffers GPS locally, persists periodically, reloads after restart, and syncs once the activity can be uploaded.
tradeoff: 掉电丢失窗口 vs 本地写入和电池开销
diagram:
flowchart TD
  G[GPS point]
  B[Memory buffer]
  L[Local storage]
  R[Reload after restart]
  S[Sync when online]
  G --> B --> L --> R --> S

termDefinitions.meaning: 先把最新数据暂存在内存里，再周期性落盘的缓冲区。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An in-memory buffer temporarily holds recent data before it is periodically flushed to disk.

scenario: 活动记录在内存 buffer 里累积，设备随时可能没电或被强制关闭；产品要求丢失数据不超过一个短窗口。
scenario_en: Workout data accumulates in an in-memory buffer, but the device may lose power or be killed; data loss must stay within a short window.
q: 为什么把内存 buffer 刷到本地存储的频率定在约 10 秒，而不是 1 秒或 1 小时？
q_en: Why flush the in-memory buffer to local storage about every 10 seconds instead of every second or every hour?
options: 10 秒能控制掉电丢失窗口，又不过度耗电和 I/O
只有刚好 10 秒才能触发 iOS 和 Android 的系统权限
频率设置得越低，掉电时反而丢失数据越少
持久化频率高低和电池、I/O 消耗完全无关
options_en: Ten seconds bounds the shutdown data-loss window without excess battery or I/O cost
Only exactly ten seconds triggers iOS and Android system permissions
A lower frequency actually loses less data on shutdown
Persistence frequency has nothing to do with battery or I/O cost
why: 更短的间隔丢失数据更少但更费电和 I/O；更长的间隔省资源但掉电损失更大，10 秒左右是常见折中点。
why_en: A shorter interval loses less data but costs more battery and I/O, while a longer one saves resources but risks losing more, so about ten seconds is a common middle ground.
optionExplanations: 这是真正的折中点：间隔太短耗电耗 I/O，太长掉电丢得多，10 秒左右让两头代价都可接受。
误解：iOS/Android 没有"刚好 10 秒"才触发系统权限的机制，这是编造的技术细节。
误解：反了——间隔越低（写得越勤）丢失窗口才越小，频率调低反而会丢更多数据。
误解：写盘次数越多越费电和 I/O，持久化频率和资源消耗直接相关，不是无关变量。
optionExplanations_en: This is the real trade-off point: too short burns battery and I/O, too long risks more loss on shutdown, and about ten seconds keeps both costs tolerable.
Misconception: there is no iOS/Android mechanism that only unlocks system permissions at exactly ten seconds — that detail is made up.
Misconception: it's backwards — a lower interval (writing more often) shrinks the loss window; lowering frequency actually loses more data.
Misconception: more disk writes cost more battery and I/O directly, so persistence frequency is not an unrelated variable.

scenario: 一次长距离骑行产生大量 GPS 坐标和 timestamp，需要可靠保存在手机上直到上传。
scenario_en: A long ride generates many GPS coordinates and timestamps that must stay reliably on the phone until upload.
q: 本地存储更合适用什么类型？
q_en: What type of local storage fits long route data best?
options: 只放进内存数组
SQLite/Room/Core Data 这类结构化本地数据库
UserDefaults/SharedPreferences 存完整大路线
写到系统剪贴板
options_en: Keep it only in an in-memory array
A structured local database such as SQLite, Room, or Core Data
UserDefaults or SharedPreferences holding the full large route
Write it to the system clipboard
why: 长路线是结构化且体量较大的数据，本地数据库比简单键值存储或纯内存更稳妥可靠。
why_en: A long route is structured and sizeable, so a local database is more reliable than simple key-value storage or memory alone.
whenOtherWins: 少量简单配置或 feature flag 可用 UserDefaults/SharedPreferences；路线数据更适合本地数据库。
tradeoff: 结构化数据库的可靠性 vs 键值存储的轻量

termDefinitions.meaning: 移动端结构化本地数据库方案（Android 用 Room，iOS 用 Core Data，底层常基于 SQLite）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SQLite, Room, and Core Data are structured local database options on mobile, with Room on Android and Core Data on iOS.

termDefinitions.meaning: 移动端简单键值本地存储，用于少量配置而非大数据集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: UserDefaults and SharedPreferences are simple mobile key-value stores meant for small settings, not large datasets.

optionExplanations: 纯内存数组重启或被系统杀进程就清空，长距离骑行的数据会整段消失。
SQLite/Room/Core Data 能按行存坐标点并建索引，几百上千个点也能可靠查询和恢复。
这类键值存储是给小配置用的，硬塞一整条大路线会让单条 value 过大、读写效率变差。
剪贴板是给用户临时复制粘贴用的，系统会随时清空，不是持久化数据的地方。
optionExplanations_en: A plain in-memory array clears the moment the app restarts or the OS kills the process, wiping out a whole long ride.
SQLite, Room, or Core Data can store each coordinate as a row with an index, staying reliable and queryable even for hundreds of points.
These key-value stores are meant for small settings; cramming an entire large route into one value bloats it and hurts read/write performance.
The clipboard is for the user's temporary copy-paste and the OS can clear it anytime — it's not a place for durable data.

scenario: 一次 3 小时骑行全程在手机上采 GPS 并落盘，用户抱怨电量掉得太快。
scenario_en: A three-hour ride samples and persists GPS on the phone the whole way, and users complain the battery drains too fast.
q: GPS 采样和本地持久化频率设置过高的主要代价是什么？
q_en: What is the main cost of setting GPS sampling and local persistence frequency too high?
options: 本地保存的好友关系记录一定会重复
数据库层再也无法做水平分片
电池和 I/O 消耗增加
已记录的路线再也画不到地图上
options_en: Locally stored friend relationships are guaranteed to duplicate
The database layer can no longer be horizontally sharded
Battery and I/O consumption increase
A recorded route can no longer be drawn on a map
why: 更高频率的采样和持久化能提高精度和耐久性，但会更耗电、更耗本地 I/O，需要在体验和成本间折中。
why_en: Higher sampling and persistence frequency improves precision and durability but costs more battery and local I/O.
optionExplanations: 误解：好友边是否重复由建表和索引约束决定，跟 GPS 采样频率毫无关系。
误解：分片策略是数据库层设计，跟客户端多久采一次 GPS 完全是两回事。
采样越勤、写盘越勤，CPU、电量消耗和磁盘 I/O 都会同步升高，这是最直接的代价。
误解：地图渲染靠的是坐标数据本身在不在，跟采样频率高低没有因果关系。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: whether friend edges duplicate is decided by the table schema and constraints, not by GPS sampling frequency.
Misconception: sharding strategy is a database-layer decision, unrelated to how often the client samples GPS.
Sampling and writing more often drives up CPU, battery, and disk I/O together — that is the most direct cost.
Misconception: map rendering just needs the coordinate data to exist; it has no causal link to sampling frequency.

scenario: 活动时间很长，路线点很多，一次上传可能 payload 太大或网络不稳定。
scenario_en: A long activity has many route points, so one upload may have a large payload or hit an unstable network.
q: 上传策略应如何处理？
q_en: How should the upload strategy handle long activities and weak networks?
options: 必须一次性整体上传，失败就把整段丢弃
每个点单独建立一个账号
按 chunk 分块上传并支持重试
只上传第一和最后一个点
options_en: Must upload everything in one shot and discard the whole thing on failure
Create a separate account for every GPS point
Upload in chunks with retry support
Upload only the first and last point
why: 分块上传降低单次请求体积，网络恢复时能断点重试，适合长活动和弱网环境。
why_en: Chunked uploads shrink each request and allow retrying from where it left off, which suits long activities on weak networks.
whenOtherWins: 短活动、网络稳定且 payload 小时，单次上传更简单。
tradeoff: 分块重试的可靠性 vs 单次上传的简单
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Activity complete]
  Q[Upload chunks]
  B[Backoff on failure]
  D[Deduplicate by activity id]
  V[Visible in feed]
  A --> Q --> D --> V
  Q -->|fail| B --> Q

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件或大量数据切成多个小块分批传输。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Chunking splits a large payload into smaller pieces that are transferred in batches.

optionExplanations: 长活动的 payload 可能很大，弱网下整体一次性上传失败率高，失败就丢弃等于白记录一次。
账号是身份实体，跟一个个 GPS 点完全不是一个层级的概念，这个说法混淆了两种资源。
把路线切成小块依次传，弱网下哪块失败就重传哪块，不用整段重来。
只留首尾两个点会让路线中间全部消失，距离和地图都会严重失真。
optionExplanations_en: A long activity's payload can be large, and an all-or-nothing upload has a high failure rate on weak networks — discarding on failure wastes the whole recording.
An account is an identity entity, a completely different layer from an individual GPS point — this option confuses two unrelated resources.
Slicing the route into small chunks lets a failed chunk retry on its own instead of resending the whole activity.
Keeping only the first and last point erases the entire middle of the route, badly distorting both distance and the map.

scenario: 1 亿用户每几秒一个 GPS 点，直写服务端写量爆炸；但活动结束后仍要能分享。
scenario_en: With 100 million users emitting a GPS point every few seconds, writing straight to the server explodes load, yet finished activities still need to be shareable.
q: 本地记录、完成后同步同时解决了哪些问题？（多选）
q_en: Which problems are solved by local recording followed by sync after completion? (Choose all that apply)
options: 无网络也能记录
服务端永远不需要保存活动
大幅减少服务端每几秒一次的位置写入
运动中统计可本地同步更新
options_en: Recording still works without network
The server never needs to save activities
Backend position-write traffic drops sharply
In-workout stats update locally in sync
why: 离线优先把写负载和实时统计留在设备上，但完成后的活动仍要上传服务端以便保存和分享。
why_en: Offline-first keeps write load and live stats on the device, but completed activities still upload to the server for persistence and sharing.
optionExplanations: 这是离线优先最直接的收益：断网时记录逻辑照常运行，不依赖服务端在线。
误解：完成后的活动仍要上传服务端持久化和分享给好友，这一步省不掉。
原本每几秒一次的位置上报改成完成后批量传，写请求量级直接下降。
距离、配速这些统计在本地实时算出来，用户不用等服务端响应就能看到。
optionExplanations_en: This is offline-first's most direct payoff: tracking logic keeps running when disconnected, with no dependency on the server being reachable.
Misconception: a completed activity still has to upload to the server for persistence and sharing with friends — that step can't be skipped.
What used to be a position report every few seconds becomes one batch upload after completion, cutting write request volume outright.
Distance and pace get computed locally in real time, so the athlete sees stats without waiting on a server response.

scenario: 改成本地记录、完成后才上传之前，客户端原本每几秒就要 POST 一次 GPS 坐标给服务端。
scenario_en: Before switching to local recording and post-completion upload, the client would POST GPS coordinates to the server every few seconds.
q: 把上报方式换成完成后批量同步，对后端写请求量级的影响是什么？
q_en: How does switching to batch sync after completion change backend write request volume?
options: 大幅下降，量级上少了大约两个数量级（约百倍）
略微下降，只少了几成
基本不变，因为总数据量没变
反而会上升，因为完成时还要额外多传一次完整活动数据
options_en: It drops sharply, roughly two orders of magnitude (about 100x) fewer requests
It drops only slightly, by a fraction
It stays about the same because total data volume is unchanged
It actually rises because a full activity payload is sent once more at completion
why: 从每几秒一次位置上报改成完成时批量同步，后端写请求从每活动上千次降到一次，量级上减少约百倍。
why_en: Moving from per-second position updates to a single batch upload after completion cuts backend write requests by roughly two orders of magnitude.
optionExplanations: 算一下就知道：原来每几秒一次、一次活动上千次请求，改成完成时一次，量级差了约两个数量级。
误解：低估了变化幅度——从"每几秒一次"变成"每次活动一次"，降幅远不止几成。
误解：把请求数量和总数据量搞混了——总字节数接近，但请求次数从上千次降到 1 次。
误解：批量上传是把原本上千次小请求合并成一次大请求，总请求数是下降的，不是上升。
optionExplanations_en: Do the math: what used to be thousands of requests per activity every few seconds becomes one request on completion — roughly two orders of magnitude fewer.
Misconception: this understates the drop — going from 'every few seconds' to 'once per activity' cuts far more than a fraction.
Misconception: this conflates request count with total data volume — total bytes stay similar, but request count drops from thousands to one.
Misconception: batching merges thousands of small requests into one larger request, so total request count goes down, not up.

scenario: 离线优先后，服务端主要处理活动创建/完成上传/活动读取，没有明显读写路径需要独立扩展。
scenario_en: After offline-first tracking, the backend mostly handles activity creation, completed uploads, and reads; no path clearly needs independent scaling.
q: 后端服务拆分的合理判断是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable backend service-splitting decision here?
options: 必须为每一个 API endpoint 单独建一个微服务
把所有业务逻辑都放进数据库触发器里执行
认为可以直接取消整个服务端
保持简单 Activity Service，水平扩展即可
options_en: Build a separate microservice for every single API endpoint
Put all business logic inside database triggers
Assume the entire backend can simply be removed
Keep a simple Activity Service and just scale it horizontally
why: 客户端已承担高频记录逻辑，服务端读写压力和职责相对集中，简单服务加水平扩展更贴合当前规模。
why_en: Since the client owns high-frequency tracking, backend load stays modest and centralized, so a simple horizontally scaled service fits.
whenOtherWins: 如果后续出现明显读写 skew、独立团队边界或实时分享高压路径，再拆服务更合理。
tradeoff: 简单集中服务 vs 提前拆分微服务
optionExplanations: endpoint 数量不等于职责边界，按端点强拆微服务会在流量还集中时先背上运维成本。
触发器适合做简单的行级约束，把创建、上传、查询这类业务流程塞进去会很难维护和排错。
客户端只是接管了实时记录，持久化、鉴权、好友读取这些职责服务端仍然要负责。
当前读写压力集中在一个 Activity 相关的路径上，多开几个实例横向扩容就够用，不用提前拆分。
optionExplanations_en: Endpoint count isn't the same as a responsibility boundary; splitting a microservice per endpoint front-loads ops cost while traffic is still concentrated.
Triggers are fine for simple row-level constraints; cramming create/upload/query business flows into them makes debugging and maintenance painful.
The client only took over live tracking — persistence, auth, and friend reads are still the backend's job.
Read and write pressure right now sits on one Activity-related path, so adding more instances horizontally is enough without splitting early.

scenario: 产品约有 1 亿 DAU，假设每人每天完成一次活动，这样一年新增的 Activity 记录约是 365 亿条。
scenario_en: With about 100 million DAU and one completed activity per user per day, the system adds about 36.5 billion Activity records per year.
q: 这个年增量级最支持下面哪个数据库设计判断？
q_en: Which database design judgment does this yearly growth estimate support most?
options: 单表单机很快撑不住，需要分片和归档策略
数据量小到可以把整年的数据都放进内存缓存里
说明必须放弃关系型数据库
这个规模下不需要再考虑存储成本
options_en: A single table on one machine cannot hold this; it needs sharding and archiving
The volume is small enough to keep an entire year of data in memory cache
This means relational databases must be abandoned
At this scale, storage cost is not worth worrying about
why: 百亿级年增量（1 亿 DAU × 1 次/天 × 365 天 ≈ 365 亿条）在单机单表上很快会遇到容量和索引瓶颈，需要按时间分片并对旧数据分层归档。
why_en: Tens of billions of new rows per year (100M DAU × 1/day × 365 days ≈ 36.5B) quickly outgrow a single table and machine, so sharding by time and tiering older data becomes necessary.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日活跃用户数，每天至少使用一次产品的用户数量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: DAU is the number of unique users who use the product at least once per day.

optionExplanations: 主计量单位是行数不是字节：亿级行数下单表索引会先失控，得按时间分片、旧数据挪去归档层。
误解：内存/缓存放的是热数据子集，365 亿条全量数据根本装不进单机内存。
误解：关系型数据库在有分片和归档策略配合时依然能扛住这个量级，不必整体放弃。
误解：存储成本随行数线性增长，百亿级数据完全不是可以忽略成本的规模。
optionExplanations_en: The primary unit is row count, not bytes: index health breaks down first at billions of rows, so shard by time and move old data to an archive tier.
Misconception: memory/cache holds a hot subset of data; 36.5 billion rows can't fit in a single machine's memory at all.
Misconception: a relational database can still handle this volume when paired with sharding and archiving — it doesn't need to be abandoned outright.
Misconception: storage cost scales roughly linearly with row count, and tens of billions of rows is not a scale where cost can be ignored.

scenario: 一次平均 30 分钟的活动，按约每 3 秒采集一个 GPS 坐标，会产生约 600 个 route point。
scenario_en: An average 30-minute activity sampled about every 3 seconds produces roughly 600 route points.
q: 600 个点这个量级最支持哪个 route 数据的设计判断？
q_en: What route-data design judgment does the 600-point estimate support?
options: 适合作为结构化的多行数据存进数据库，而不是塞进一个巨大字段
600 个点数太少，完全不需要任何专门的存储优化设计
600 个点数量还太多，必须改用视频编码来压缩整条路线
应该只保留起点和终点两个点，中间的路线点全部可以丢弃
options_en: It fits as structured multi-row data in the database, not one giant blob field
600 points is too small a count to need any dedicated storage optimization at all
600 points is still too many, so the route must be recompressed using video encoding
Only the two endpoints should be kept, with every middle route point dropped entirely
why: 约 600 个带经纬度和时间戳的点是常规结构化数据规模，适合按行存储和索引，不需要极端压缩，也不该丢弃中间点。
why_en: About 600 timestamped coordinate points is a normal structured-data volume that fits row storage and indexing without extreme compression.
optionExplanations: 600 个带经纬度和时间戳的点就是普通的结构化行数据，按行存表、建索引就能查询，不用塞进一个大字段。
误解：600 个点已经是要考虑存储和索引设计的规模，"太少不用管"低估了它的量级。
误解：600 个坐标点是几十 KB 级别的结构化数据，远够不上要上视频编码这种重型压缩手段。
误解：只留首尾会让路线中间全部消失，配速、爬升这些依赖中间点的统计也会跟着算不出来。
optionExplanations_en: 600 timestamped coordinate points is a routine amount of structured data — store it as rows with an index, no giant field needed.
Misconception: 600 points is already a scale worth structuring and indexing; 'too small to matter' undersells it.
Misconception: 600 coordinates is tens of kilobytes of structured data, nowhere near the scale that would call for video-style compression.
Misconception: keeping only the endpoints erases the entire middle of the route, so pace and elevation stats that need those points break too.

scenario: 每条活动的路线数据约 15KB，一年约 365 亿条活动，算下来路线存储总量约 547.5TB/年。
scenario_en: Each activity's route data is about 15KB, and 36.5 billion activities per year produce roughly 547.5TB of route storage annually.
q: 这个存储量级最支持哪个基础设施判断？
q_en: Which infrastructure judgment does this storage estimate support?
options: 数据量大但可管理，适合分片加冷热分层，而不是放弃持久化
数据量小到可以只用一台单机 Redis 就全量保存下来
数据量已经大到必须放弃关系型建模
这个量级下缓存能完全替代持久化存储
options_en: It's large but manageable with sharding and tiered storage, not a reason to skip persistence
It is small enough that a single-node Redis instance can hold all of it
It's so large that relational modeling must be abandoned
At this scale, caching can fully replace persistent storage
why: 547.5TB/年是大但可管理的规模，用分片和冷热分层就能控制成本，不需要放弃关系建模或指望缓存顶替持久化。
why_en: 547.5TB per year is large but manageable with sharding and tiered storage, without abandoning relational modeling or relying on cache alone.
optionExplanations: 547.5TB/年是"大但可管理"的典型区间：主计量单位是分片数和冷热层级，而不是要不要放弃持久化。
误解：单机 Redis 是内存级容量，547.5TB 根本不可能塞进一台机器的内存。
误解：关系型建模本身没问题，问题是要不要在关系模型上叠加分片，不必整体抛弃。
误解：缓存只是加速热数据读取的一层，它没有持久化保证，掉电或重启会丢数据。
optionExplanations_en: 547.5TB per year sits squarely in 'large but manageable': the unit that matters is shard count and hot/cold tiering, not whether to abandon persistence.
Misconception: a single Redis instance's capacity is memory-bound, and 547.5TB simply cannot fit in one machine's RAM.
Misconception: relational modeling itself isn't the problem — the real question is layering sharding on top of it, not scrapping it entirely.
Misconception: cache is only a layer that speeds up hot reads; it has no durability guarantee and loses data on restart or power loss.

q: 补全路线存储估算：
q_en: Complete the route storage estimate:
text: 一个 route point 可近似为 latitude {{8 bytes}} + longitude {{8 bytes}} + timestamp {{8 bytes}}，600 个点约为 {{15KB}}。
why: 这种估算帮助判断数据量很大但不离谱，从而选择分片和冷热分层而不是过度复杂化。
why_en: This estimate shows route data is large but manageable with sharding and tiered storage rather than exotic infrastructure.

scenario: 活动数据每年数百 TB，查询大多看最近活动或近期好友动态。
scenario_en: Activity data grows by hundreds of TB per year, and most queries look at recent activities or recent friend feeds.
q: 活动数据库的一个合理分片维度是什么？
q_en: What is a reasonable sharding dimension for the activity database?
options: 按用户昵称的首字母随机做分片
按活动完成时间分片
按 GPS 坐标纬度的第一位数字分片
所有历史数据永远放在单表单机上
options_en: Shard randomly by the first letter of the username
Shard by activity completion time
Shard by the first digit of the GPS latitude coordinate
Keep all history forever in one table on one machine
why: 多数查询集中在近期窗口（rule of thumb：约 80% 的读落在最近 30 天内），按完成时间分片贴合访问模式，也方便把老分片整体归档。
why_en: Since most reads cluster in a recent window (rule of thumb: roughly 80% within the last 30 days), sharding by completion time matches access patterns and simplifies archiving old shards.
whenOtherWins: 如果主要查询总是某个用户的完整历史，userId 分片或复合分区会更重要。
tradeoff: 近期查询效率 vs 单用户全历史查询效率

termDefinitions.meaning: 把一张大表的数据水平拆分到多个数据库实例上。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits a large table's rows horizontally across multiple database instances.

optionExplanations: 按昵称首字母分片和查询模式（看最近活动）完全对不上，同一分片里新旧活动混在一起，起不到归档作用。
多数查询只看近期窗口，按完成时间分片能把同一批老数据聚在一起，整体归档也方便。
纬度第一位数字只反映地理位置，运动地点和查询是否是近期活动没有关系，容易踩到地理热点。
不分片意味着单机要扛住全部历史增长，百亿级行数下索引和容量迟早会先垮掉。
optionExplanations_en: Sharding by the first letter of a username has nothing to do with the access pattern of recent activity; old and new rows stay mixed in the same shard.
Since most reads target a recent window, sharding by completion time keeps a batch of aging data together, making bulk archiving easy.
The first digit of latitude only encodes geography, unrelated to whether a query wants recent activity, and it invites geographic hot shards.
No sharding means a single machine absorbs all historical growth, and at tens of billions of rows the index and capacity give out eventually.

scenario: 用户极少查看多年前的路线，但最近活动列表和详情必须加载快。
scenario_en: Users rarely open routes from many years ago, but recent lists and details must load quickly.
q: 合理的存储分层是什么？
q_en: What storage tiering strategy fits this access pattern?
options: 所有活动数据永远保存在 Redis 里
所有历史数据每次都从手机重新上传
近期数据放快速存储，1 年以上归档到 S3
数据库里只保留最近一天的活动
options_en: Keep all activity data permanently inside Redis
Re-upload all historical data from the phone every time
Keep recent data on fast storage and archive anything over a year old to S3
Keep only the last day of activities in the database
why: 冷热分层按访问频率换存储成本：近期活动留在快速层，老活动挪到归档层仍可按需读取。
why_en: Tiered storage trades access frequency for cost, keeping recent activities fast while older ones move to cheaper archival tiers.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品承诺所有历史秒开且访问频繁，warm/hot 保留时间要更长。
tradeoff: 分层节省成本 vs 全量高速存储的简单一致
diagram:
flowchart TD
  H[Hot activity metadata]
  C[Cached summaries]
  O[Cold route blobs]
  H --> C
  H --> O

termDefinitions.meaning: 给很少访问的旧数据用的低成本、慢速存储层，如 S3 归档。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold storage is a low-cost, slower storage tier for rarely accessed old data, such as S3 archival.

optionExplanations: Redis 是内存级缓存，拿它长期存全部活动既昂贵又没必要，它该做的是加速热点读取。
手机重新上传意味着客户端要永久留着全部历史原始数据，既浪费本地空间也没必要反复占用带宽。
近一年内常被访问的活动留在快速层，超过一年的挪到 S3 归档层，需要时仍能按需取回。
只留一天会让用户看不到稍早的历史活动，直接违背查看自己历史记录的基本需求。
optionExplanations_en: Redis is memory-speed cache; keeping every activity there forever is both expensive and unnecessary — its job is speeding up hot reads.
Re-uploading from the phone means the client has to hold onto all raw history forever, wasting local space and bandwidth for no reason.
Activities accessed often within the last year stay on the fast tier, and anything older moves to S3 archival, still retrievable on demand.
Keeping only one day means users lose access to anything slightly older, breaking the basic need to view your own history.

scenario: 活动读取吞吐目前不高，主要压力是长期数据量；只有少数热门活动详情被反复查看。
scenario_en: Activity read throughput is not high yet; long-term data growth is the main pressure, with only a few hot activity details repeatedly viewed.
q: 缓存应该如何优先级排序？
q_en: How should caching be prioritized in this Strava design?
options: 一开始就把所有路线数据都缓存进 Redis
不是首要优先级，等热点变慢再加缓存
任何情况下都完全不允许使用缓存
缓存能够完全替代数据库分片和归档策略
options_en: Cache all route data into Redis from the very start
Not the first priority; add caching once hotspots slow down
Never allow caching under any circumstances
Caching can fully replace database sharding and archiving
why: 当前读吞吐不是主要压力，存储增长才是；缓存适合在具体热点和延迟问题出现后再补上。
why_en: Read throughput isn't the current pressure, storage growth is, so caching is best added later once specific hotspots appear.
whenOtherWins: 若某些明星活动或活动 feed 被频繁访问，缓存会更快成为必要组件。
tradeoff: 先解决存储增长 vs 提前引入缓存复杂度
optionExplanations: 读吞吐现在还不高，提前把全部路线塞进 Redis 会先背上内存成本，却换不来明显收益。
现在的瓶颈是存储持续增长，不是读延迟；等具体某类查询变慢了再针对性加缓存更划算。
完全禁用等于放弃了以后应对热点读的手段，热点一旦出现会没有缓冲余地。
缓存只加速读取，它没有持久化保证；分片和归档解决的是数据放哪、放多久，两者不能互相替代。
optionExplanations_en: Read throughput is not high yet, so caching every route into Redis upfront front-loads memory cost without a matching payoff.
The current bottleneck is ongoing storage growth, not read latency; adding caching once a specific query actually gets slow is the better-timed move.
Banning caching outright gives up the tool needed once a real hotspot shows up, leaving no cushion when it does.
Cache only speeds up reads and carries no durability guarantee; sharding and archiving decide where data lives and for how long — neither replaces the other.

scenario: 用户打开列表页，需要看自己的已完成活动或好友已完成活动，每项只展示距离、时间、日期等摘要。
scenario_en: A user opens a list of their own or friends' completed activities, and each row only shows summary fields like distance, time, and date.
q: 列表接口应该返回什么形态？
q_en: What shape should the activity-list API return?
options: 列表接口把完整路线的所有 GPS 坐标点都整段返回
列表接口把所有好友关系和用户的全部历史记录一起打包返回
分页返回 Partial<Activity>，只含摘要字段
列表接口直接返回地图瓦片服务生成的原始图片文件
options_en: The list endpoint returns the full route with every GPS coordinate point in one long payload
The list endpoint bundles all friend relationships and the user's entire history together
Return a paginated Partial<Activity> with only summary fields
The list endpoint returns raw map tile image files straight from the tile service
why: 列表页只需距离、时间等摘要字段，返回完整 route 会让 payload 过大、滚动变慢；详情页再单独请求完整数据。
why_en: The list view only needs summary fields like distance and time; returning the full route would bloat the payload and slow scrolling.
whenOtherWins: 如果是导出 GPX 或打开详情页，才需要完整 route 数据。
tradeoff: 列表轻量摘要 vs 详情完整数据

termDefinitions.meaning: 把长列表拆成一页页返回，避免一次传输过多数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination splits a long list into pages so the server doesn't return too much data at once.

optionExplanations: 列表页只是滚动浏览摘要，把完整坐标点全塞进每一行会让 payload 暴涨、滚动明显变卡。
好友关系和历史记录属于不同资源，混进列表响应会让接口边界模糊，也白白传输用户不需要的数据。
列表只需要距离、时间这些摘要字段，分页返回 Partial<Activity> 刚好够用又省流量，详情页再单独取全量。
地图瓦片是地图服务按需生成和缓存的图片资源，活动列表接口不该越俎代庖去处理它。
optionExplanations_en: The list view is just a scrolling summary; packing every coordinate into each row bloats the payload and visibly slows scrolling.
Friend relationships and history are different resources; folding them into the list response blurs the API boundary and ships data nobody asked for.
The list only needs fields like distance and time, so a paginated Partial<Activity> is just enough and saves bandwidth — the detail page fetches the full route separately.
Map tiles are images the map service generates and caches on demand; the activity list endpoint has no business handling that.

scenario: 好友关系用 friends(userId, friendId) 存双向边，活动列表要查询当前用户好友的已完成活动。
scenario_en: Friend edges are stored as friends(userId, friendId) in both directions, and the feed needs completed activities from the current user's friends.
q: 哪类查询最贴合这个需求？
q_en: Which query pattern best fits this friend-activity feed?
options: 把所有活动拉到客户端本地再逐条过滤
只查询当前登录用户自己的活动
用 IN 子查询按 friends 表过滤好友的已完成活动
在整张活动表上按 activityId 做完全随机的抽样查询
options_en: Pull all activities to the client and filter them one by one
Only query the currently logged-in user's own activities
Use an IN subquery against the friends table to filter completed friend activities
Run a fully random sample query over the whole activity table by activityId
why: friends 表在 userId 上建了索引，用 IN 子查询直接在数据库端过滤已完成活动并分页，网络传输最少。
why_en: With an index on userId, an IN subquery filters completed friend activities inside the database and keeps network transfer minimal.
whenOtherWins: 超大好友图和高频 feed 可用预计算 feed 或 fanout；基础设计用查询即可。
tradeoff: 数据库端过滤 vs 客户端拉全量再过滤
codeSample:
SELECT * FROM activities
WHERE state = 'COMPLETE'
AND user_id IN (SELECT friend_id FROM friends WHERE user_id = :user_id)
LIMIT :page_size OFFSET :offset;

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库里加速查询的辅助结构，避免全表扫描。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index is a database structure that speeds up lookups without scanning the whole table.

optionExplanations: 把全量活动传到客户端再本地筛，等于放弃了数据库索引，网络传输和内存占用都会先炸。
只查自己的活动压根没用到 friends 表，构不成好友动态流，这条路线走偏了。
用户和好友的边已经建了索引，子查询能直接命中索引筛出好友的已完成活动，再分页返回，客户端不用等全表结果。
随机抽样连"是不是好友的活动"这个过滤条件都没保证，返回结果可能完全不相关。
optionExplanations_en: Shipping every activity to the client and filtering locally throws away the database index, so network transfer and memory both blow up first.
Querying only the logged-in user's own activities never touches the friends table, so it can't produce a friend feed at all — wrong path.
The user-friend edge is already indexed, so the subquery hits that index to pull completed friend activities directly, then paginates — the client never waits on a full-table result.
Random sampling by activityId doesn't even guarantee the 'is this a friend's activity' filter, so results could be completely unrelated.

scenario: 打开好友动态页要先取某用户的全部好友 id；好友关系是双向的，且不能出现重复边。
scenario_en: Opening the friend feed first needs all of a user’s friend ids; friendship is mutual and duplicate edges must never appear.
q: friends 表用 (userId, friendId) 双向各存一行，并在 userId 上建索引，主要好处是什么？
q_en: Why store both directions in friends(userId, friendId) and index userId?
options: 让设备的 GPS 定位变得更精确
自动帮客户端完成活动上传
直接替代掉整张 Activity 活动表
快速查某个用户的好友并避免重复边
options_en: Makes the device GPS positioning more accurate
Automatically completes activity uploads for the client
Directly replaces the entire Activity table
Fast friend lookup while preventing duplicate edges
why: 双向各存一行让查某人的好友变成单向索引查找，复合主键 (userId, friendId) 防止同一条边被重复插入。
why_en: Storing both directions turns friend lookup into a simple indexed query, and the composite key prevents duplicate edges.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多个字段共同组成的主键，用于唯一标识一行并防止重复。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A composite primary key combines multiple columns to uniquely identify a row and prevent duplicates.

optionExplanations: 误解：GPS 精度由定位硬件和信号环境决定，跟好友表怎么设计索引毫无关系。
误解：活动上传走的是 Activity 相关接口，friends 表的索引不参与这个流程。
误解：friends 表记录的是关系边，Activity 表记录的是活动本身，两张表各管各的，不存在谁替代谁。
正反各存一条边，找某人的好友就退化成一次索引命中；userId 加 friendId 组成的联合主键挡住了同一条边被插两遍。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: GPS accuracy is set by positioning hardware and signal conditions, unrelated to how the friends table is indexed.
Misconception: activity uploads go through Activity-related endpoints; the friends table index plays no part in that flow.
Misconception: friends stores relationship edges while Activity stores the activity itself — separate tables, neither substitutes for the other.
Storing the edge in both directions turns finding someone's friends into a single indexed hit, and the (userId, friendId) composite key blocks the same edge from being inserted twice.

scenario: 用户点进活动详情页，需要在地图上显示跑步路线。
scenario_en: A user opens an activity detail page and needs to see the running route on a map.
q: 路线地图展示需要后端提供什么？
q_en: What should the backend provide so the route can be shown on a map?
options: 把整场运动过程录制成完整视频再逐帧传给前端
GPS 坐标数组，交给地图 API 画 polyline
服务端预先截图生成一张固定死、完全不可缩放的静态图片
把好友账号的登录密码字段一并返回给前端展示
options_en: Record the entire workout as a full video and stream it frame by frame to the frontend
A GPS coordinate array that a map API renders as a polyline
The server pre-renders one fixed, completely non-zoomable static screenshot image
Return the friend account's login password field along with the display data
why: 详情页拿到坐标数组后，用地图 API（如 Google Maps）把点连成 polyline，用户还能交互缩放。
why_en: The detail page takes the coordinate array and lets a map API draw a polyline that users can pan and zoom.
whenOtherWins: 若目标是缩略图或分享卡片，服务端预渲染静态地图图像也可能更高效。
tradeoff: 坐标数组的前端灵活渲染 vs 服务端预渲染静态图的省算力

termDefinitions.meaning: 地图上连接一串坐标点的折线，用来画出运动路线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A polyline is a line connecting a sequence of coordinates, used to draw a route on a map.

optionExplanations: 视频是媒体数据，体积比坐标点大好几个数量级，存储和带宽成本完全不成比例。
坐标数组交给前端地图 SDK 连成 polyline，用户能自由平移缩放，数据量也只是几百个点。
静态图适合分享缩略图，但详情页要支持缩放平移，固定图片没法满足交互需求。
登录密码和路线渲染毫不相关，这个选项本身就是明显跑题的安全隐患。
optionExplanations_en: Video is media data, orders of magnitude larger than coordinate points — storage and bandwidth cost become wildly disproportionate.
The coordinate array goes to the frontend's map SDK to draw a polyline, letting users pan and zoom freely while staying just a few hundred points.
A static image works for a share thumbnail, but the detail page needs pan and zoom, which a fixed image cannot deliver.
A login password has nothing to do with rendering a route — this option is an obvious off-topic security red flag.

scenario: 新增需求：好友可以在你跑步时近实时看到路线和数据，但几秒延迟可接受。
scenario_en: New requirement: friends can watch your route and stats while you run, with a few seconds of delay acceptable.
q: 活动中的设备应如何对服务端上报？
q_en: How should the active device report data to the backend during live sharing?
options: 运动过程中完全停止客户端上所有的本地计算和实时统计显示
本地继续算给本人看，同时每 2-5 秒上传位置供好友查看
只在整场活动彻底结束之后才允许好友看到任何内容
不管信号好坏都每隔一毫秒发送一次位置更新
options_en: Stop all local client computation and live-stat display entirely during the workout
Keep computing locally for the athlete while uploading location every 2-5 seconds for friends
Only let friends see anything after the entire activity has fully ended
Send a location update every single millisecond no matter how good or bad the signal is
why: 实时分享需要重新引入周期性上传，但本人的体验仍应由本地数据驱动，不受网络波动影响。
why_en: Realtime sharing reintroduces periodic uploads for friends while the athlete's own experience stays driven by local data.
whenOtherWins: 若没有实时分享需求，完成后一次性同步更简单、更省电、更省服务端资源。
tradeoff: 好友近实时可见 vs 本人体验对网络的独立性
optionExplanations: 本人的本地统计不依赖网络，一停就等于把无网络也能用的核心能力也一起关掉了。
本地照常算给本人看，同时另开一条 2-5 秒周期的上传通道喂给好友端，两条路径互不阻塞。
完成后才可见等于放弃了"近实时观看"这个新增需求，退回成离线优先的旧行为。
毫秒级上报远超几秒延迟可接受的实际需要，电池和服务端都会被无谓的高频请求拖垮。
optionExplanations_en: The athlete's own local stats don't depend on the network, so stopping them also throws away the offline capability that's core to this design.
Keep computing locally as always for the athlete, while a separate 2-5 second upload channel feeds friends — the two paths do not block each other.
Waiting until completion to show anything abandons the new near-real-time viewing requirement and falls back to old offline-first behavior.
Millisecond-level reporting is far beyond what a few seconds of acceptable delay calls for, and it would drown both battery and backend in needless requests.

scenario: 好友看 live activity 时，位置更新可预测每 2-5 秒一次，几秒滞后可接受，主要是只读查看。
scenario_en: For live activity viewing, position updates arrive predictably every 2-5 seconds, a few seconds of lag is fine, and friends only read the stream.
q: 更新节奏可预测、几秒延迟可接受时，最简单可行的方案是什么？
q_en: When updates are predictable and a few seconds of delay is acceptable, what is the simplest viable approach?
options: 一定要 WebSocket/Redis pubsub 全套实时架构
让好友直接连运动者手机
好友客户端按相同节奏轮询最新活动点，略作延迟缓冲
只发短信
options_en: Require a full realtime stack with WebSocket or Redis pub/sub
Have friends connect directly to the athlete's phone
Friend clients poll at a similar cadence with a small delay buffer
Send updates only by SMS
why: 更新频率可预测且允许几秒延迟，轮询比维护长连接更简单；WebSocket/SSE 在这里是过度设计。
why_en: Because updates are predictable and a few seconds of lag is fine, polling is simpler than maintaining persistent realtime connections.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要大量观众、不可预测事件或亚秒互动，WebSocket/SSE/pubsub 会更有价值。
tradeoff: 轮询的简单性 vs 长连接的低延迟

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端按固定节奏主动向服务端请求最新数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Polling means the client periodically requests fresh data from the server on a fixed interval.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在客户端和服务端之间维持一条持久双向连接的协议。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: WebSocket is a protocol that keeps a persistent two-way connection between client and server.

termDefinitions.meaning: 服务端向客户端单向推送事件流的协议（Server-Sent Events）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SSE, or Server-Sent Events, lets a server push a one-way stream of updates to the client.

termDefinitions.meaning: 发布订阅模式，发布者广播消息，多个订阅者各自接收。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pub/sub is a pattern where a publisher broadcasts messages that multiple subscribers receive.

optionExplanations: 长连接的优势是应对不可预测的高频事件，这里更新节奏固定、延迟可接受，维护长连接是过度设计。
手机之间直连要处理 NAT 穿透、动态 IP 和安全校验，运维和风险都远超这个需求该有的复杂度。
既然更新是每 2-5 秒一次的固定节奏，好友端按同样节奏轮询，加一点缓冲就能拿到够新鲜的数据。
短信适合偶发通知，不适合承载持续更新的位置流，也没法支撑地图上的连续移动动画。
optionExplanations_en: Persistent connections shine for unpredictable high-frequency events; here the update cadence is fixed and delay is acceptable, so maintaining one is over-engineering.
Phone-to-phone connections have to deal with NAT traversal, dynamic IPs, and security checks — far more ops burden and risk than this requirement needs.
Since updates arrive on a fixed 2-5 second cadence, friends can poll at the same cadence and add a small buffer to stay fresh enough.
SMS suits occasional notifications, not a continuous position stream, and it cannot drive smooth movement animation on a map.

scenario: 好友在地图上实时观看跑者，但 GPS 点每 5-10 秒才来一个，且位置有抖动。
scenario_en: Friends watch a runner live on a map, but GPS points arrive only every five to ten seconds and the positions jitter.
q: 好友实时观看活动时，故意显示慢 1-2 个更新间隔的好处是什么？
q_en: Why intentionally show live activity data one or two update intervals behind to friends?
options: 缓冲会让本人这场活动的原始数据永久丢失
用 5-10 秒缓冲平滑动画，减少位置跳变
缓冲机制会阻止运动者事后保存这场活动
缓冲会把 GPS 定位精度直接降到 0
options_en: Buffering permanently discards the athlete's own raw activity data
Use a 5-10 second buffer to smooth the animation and reduce jumps
The buffering mechanism blocks the athlete from saving this activity afterward
Buffering drops GPS positioning accuracy straight to zero
why: 故意展示慢 1-2 个更新间隔的数据，能让前端插值出连贯动画，代价是牺牲几秒绝对实时性。
why_en: Intentionally showing data delayed by one or two intervals lets the client interpolate smooth motion, at the cost of a few seconds of freshness.
optionExplanations: 误解：缓冲只延迟好友端看到的展示，运动者本人记录的原始数据完整保留，不会丢。
好友端刻意慢 1-2 个更新间隔，前端就能在两个真实点之间插值，画面平滑不跳变，代价是几秒新鲜度。
误解：缓冲发生在好友观看这条展示路径上，跟运动者本人保存活动的存储路径没有关系。
误解：缓冲是延迟展示的时间点，不改变坐标本身的精度，GPS 精度由硬件和信号决定。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: buffering only delays what friends see; the athlete's own recorded raw data stays complete and is never lost.
Friends deliberately see data one or two intervals behind, so the client can interpolate between real points for smooth motion, at the cost of a few seconds of freshness.
Misconception: buffering happens on the friend-viewing display path, unrelated to the storage path where the athlete saves their own activity.
Misconception: buffering delays when data is displayed, not the accuracy of the coordinates themselves — GPS accuracy is set by hardware and signal.

q: 好友实时跟随活动的简单轮询链路，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct order for a simple polling-based live-follow flow?
steps: 好友客户端延迟 1-2 个 interval 后平滑播放路线
运动者客户端每 2-5 秒上传最新位置
服务端持久化最新 activity updates
好友客户端按类似节奏轮询最新点
why: 运动端周期性上传，服务端保存，好友端按节奏拉取并缓冲播放，避免维护复杂长连接。
why_en: The live-follow flow uploads periodically, stores updates, polls them from friends' clients, and buffers playback for smoothness.
tradeoff: 轮询的运维简单 vs 长连接的更低延迟
diagram:
flowchart TD
  P[Phone uploads latest point]
  S[Server stores latest view]
  F[Friend polls]
  M[Map shows slight delay]
  P --> S --> F --> M

scenario: 产品要按活动类型和距离展示 top athletes，初版想直接从 activities 表 group by user 并 sum(distance)。
scenario_en: The product wants top athletes by activity type and distance, and the naive version groups activities by user and sums distance on demand.
q: 这个朴素 leaderboard 查询的问题是什么？
q_en: What is the problem with this naive leaderboard query?
options: SQL 引擎完全无法计算 SUM 聚合
每次请求都要扫描聚合海量活动，负载很高
这样的查询会让手机 GPS 停止工作
这个查询只能用来查一个用户
options_en: The SQL engine cannot compute a SUM aggregate at all
Every request scans and aggregates huge volumes, driving up load
A query like this would make the phone's GPS stop working
This query can only ever look up a single user
why: 随着活动数增长到亿级，每次请求都全表聚合排序不能放在用户请求的热路径上。
why_en: As activity volume grows into the billions, aggregating the full table on every request cannot sit on the hot request path.
whenOtherWins: 小数据量、离线分析或后台临时报表可以先用 SQL 聚合。
tradeoff: 实时准确 vs 查询延迟和数据库负载
optionExplanations: 误解：SQL 引擎能算 SUM，瓶颈不是算不出来，是每次都从头全表算一遍太贵。
活动表增长到亿级后，每次请求都要扫描聚合全表再排序，这个开销压在用户请求的热路径上撑不住。
误解：后端查询和手机 GPS 硬件是两个完全独立的系统，数据库查询不会影响手机传感器。
误解：group by user 本来就是把多个用户各自分组聚合，不存在只能查一个用户这种限制。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: the SQL engine can compute SUM just fine; the bottleneck isn't the math, it's redoing a full scan from scratch every time.
Once the activity table reaches hundreds of millions of rows, scanning and aggregating it on every request sits on the user-facing hot path and cannot hold up.
Misconception: the backend query and the phone's GPS hardware are entirely separate systems; a database query cannot affect a phone's sensor.
Misconception: group by user already aggregates across many users at once — there is no limitation to querying just one.

scenario: 排行榜不要求实时更新，用户接受每天刷新一次。
scenario_en: The leaderboard does not need realtime updates, and users accept a daily refresh.
q: 比每次全表聚合更简单的方案是什么？
q_en: What is simpler than aggregating the full table on every request?
options: 每次排行榜查询仍然扫描并聚合全部 activities 表
周期性预聚合到 leaderboard 表，直接读取排序
把排行榜排序逻辑放进前端客户端代码里
排行榜上只随机展示几个用户
options_en: Every leaderboard query still scans and aggregates the entire activities table
Periodically pre-aggregate into a leaderboard table and read it sorted
Put leaderboard sorting logic inside the frontend client code
Show only a few random users on the leaderboard
why: 预聚合把昂贵计算从请求路径搬到后台作业，代价是排行榜会有可接受的滞后。
why_en: Periodic aggregation moves expensive computation off the request path at the cost of some staleness.
whenOtherWins: 如果活动完成后必须立刻反映排名，Redis sorted set 或流式增量更新更合适。
tradeoff: 读取速度 vs 排名新鲜度
optionExplanations: 这条路径没有解决任何问题——请求路径上的全表扫描和聚合开销原封不动地留在那里。
后台按周期把聚合结果写进一张单独的 leaderboard 表，读请求直接按 score 排序取行，热路径上没有聚合计算。
前端拿不到全量、可信的活动数据，排序结果既不准确也难以跨设备保持一致。
随机展示丢掉了"按距离排名"这个核心语义，跟需求完全不是一回事。
optionExplanations_en: This path solves nothing — the full-table scan and aggregation cost stay exactly where they were, on the request path.
A background job periodically writes aggregated results into a separate leaderboard table, so reads just sort by score with no aggregation on the hot path.
The frontend never has the complete, trustworthy activity data, so its sort would be both inaccurate and inconsistent across devices.
Showing random users throws away the core meaning of 'ranked by distance' — it isn't the same requirement at all.

scenario: 排行榜希望在新活动保存后快速更新，按跑步总距离取前 N 名。
scenario_en: The leaderboard should update quickly after a new activity is saved and rank users by total running distance.
q: 最合适的 Redis 结构是什么？
q_en: Which Redis data structure best fits this leaderboard?
options: List：每次活动都 LPUSH 一个 activityId
Sorted Set，member 是 userId，score 是距离
String：只能保存最后一个用户的记录
Pub/Sub channel：假设它能像数据库一样永久保存排行榜状态
options_en: List: LPUSH an activityId on every activity
Sorted Set, with userId as member and distance as score
String: can only store the record of the last user
Pub/Sub channel: assuming it can permanently store leaderboard state like a database
why: Sorted Set 支持按 distance score 增量更新和高效 top-N 查询，是排行榜的典型结构。
why_en: A sorted set supports incremental score updates and efficient top-N queries, the standard structure for leaderboards.
whenOtherWins: 如果只需每日榜且不实时，预聚合数据库表更便宜、更简单。
tradeoff: 实时增量排名 vs 额外的 Redis 内存和一致性成本

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的有序集合，每个成员带一个 score，天然支持按分数排序取 top N。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Redis sorted set stores members with scores and supports fast ranked top-N queries.

optionExplanations: List 只按插入顺序存元素，取不出"按距离从高到低"这种排序，取 top-N 还要额外排序。
userId 当 member、distance 当 score，ZINCRBY 累加更新，ZREVRANGE 直接按分数取前 N 名。
String 只能存一个值，第二个用户的活动一写入就把第一个用户的记录覆盖掉了。
Pub/Sub 只广播消息给当前在线的订阅者，断线或重启后订阅者收不到任何历史状态。
optionExplanations_en: A List only preserves insertion order, so 'ranked by distance' can't come out of it directly — top-N would need extra sorting anyway.
userId as the member and distance as the score lets ZINCRBY add increments and ZREVRANGE read the top N directly by score.
A String can only hold one value, so writing the second user's activity would overwrite the first user's record entirely.
Pub/Sub only broadcasts to subscribers that are online at that moment; anyone disconnected or restarted gets no history at all.

scenario: 用户完成一场 8.2km 跑步，需要更新全球跑步总距离榜并查询 top users。
scenario_en: A user completes an 8.2km run, and the system needs to update the global running-distance leaderboard and read top users.
q: 哪组 Redis 命令最贴合？
q_en: Which Redis command pair best fits this update-and-read path?
options: 用 LPUSH 加 GET 的命令组合来更新和读取排行榜
用 SET 命令直接覆盖排行榜里的一个值
ZINCRBY 累加距离，ZREVRANGE 取排名前列
用 PUBLISH 命令广播一条排行榜更新消息
options_en: Use the LPUSH plus GET command combination to update and read the leaderboard
Use a SET command to directly overwrite one value in the leaderboard
ZINCRBY to add distance, then ZREVRANGE to read the top ranks
Use a PUBLISH command to broadcast a leaderboard update message
why: ZINCRBY 给用户总距离加分，ZREVRANGE 按分数从高到低取前 N 名，两条命令就够。
why_en: ZINCRBY adds to the user's total distance and ZREVRANGE returns the top ranked members by score.
whenOtherWins: 只通知前端有新活动时可用 pub/sub；存排行榜状态要用 sorted set。
tradeoff: Sorted Set 命令的排名能力 vs 其他结构的简单但无排序
codeSample:
ZINCRBY leaderboard:run:global 8.2 user_42
ZREVRANGE leaderboard:run:global 0 49 WITHSCORES

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，把某个成员的 score 增加指定数值。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZINCRBY is a Redis command that increments a sorted-set member's score by a given amount.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 命令，按 score 从高到低取出一个范围内的成员。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ZREVRANGE is a Redis command that returns sorted-set members ordered from highest to lowest score.

optionExplanations: LPUSH 只能往列表头部塞新元素，GET 是给 String 用的读取命令，两个命令都读不出排序。
SET 会覆盖整个 key 的值，8.2km 这次跑步一写进去，之前所有用户的分数就全没了。
ZINCRBY 给这个用户的 sorted set 分数加上 8.2，ZREVRANGE 0 49 直接按分数从高到低取前 50 名。
PUBLISH 只是把消息广播给当时在线的订阅者，它不写入任何可查询的排行榜状态。
optionExplanations_en: LPUSH only pushes a new element onto a list's head, and GET reads a String value — neither command can pull anything out sorted.
SET overwrites the entire value at a key, so writing this 8.2km run would wipe out every other user's score stored there.
ZINCRBY adds 8.2 to this user's sorted-set score, and ZREVRANGE 0 49 reads the top 50 directly, ordered highest score first.
PUBLISH just broadcasts a message to whoever is subscribed at that moment; it writes no queryable leaderboard state at all.

scenario: 排行榜需要同时支持全球跑步榜和 USA 跑步榜，活动完成时可知道用户所在国家。
scenario_en: The leaderboard must support both a global running board and a USA running board, and the user's country is known when the activity completes.
q: Redis sorted set 应如何组织？
q_en: How should Redis sorted sets be organized for country leaderboards?
options: 只保留一个全局的 list，每次查询时都做一遍全量过滤
同时更新 global key 和国家专属 key
每一次请求都临时扫描全部活动数据
把国家信息写进 score 的小数部分
options_en: Keep just one global list and run a full filter pass on every query
Update both the global key and a country-specific key
Temporarily scan all activity data on every single request
Encode country information into the decimal part of the score
why: 为常用过滤维度各维护一个 sorted set，读取国家榜时直接命中对应 key，代价是多一次写入和内存。
why_en: Maintaining a sorted set per common filter dimension lets country leaderboards hit one key directly, at the cost of extra writes and memory.
whenOtherWins: 如果过滤组合很多且很少访问，不应预建所有 key，可按需计算并缓存短 TTL。
tradeoff: 查询速度 vs 写入和内存开销

termDefinitions.meaning: 缓存条目的过期时间，过期后必须重新获取或重建。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: TTL is the expiration time after which a cached entry must be fetched or rebuilt.

optionExplanations: 只有一个全局 list 意味着查国家榜时要在读时才去过滤出某个国家的成员，读延迟会随全局成员数增长。
活动完成时同时给 global key 和对应国家的 key 各 ZINCRBY 一次，读哪个榜就直接命中对应的 key。
临时扫描活动表相当于把请求路径变成了 SQL 聚合的老问题，Redis 加速排行榜的意义就没了。
score 只应该表达排序依据（距离），把国家塞进小数位会污染排序本身，距离排名直接算错。
optionExplanations_en: A single global list means filtering out one country's members has to happen at read time, and that latency grows with the global member count.
On activity completion, ZINCRBY both the global key and the matching country key, so reading either leaderboard hits its own key directly.
Scanning activity data on every request just reintroduces the old SQL-aggregation problem on the request path, defeating the point of using Redis at all.
The score should only encode the sort basis (distance); folding country into the decimal part corrupts the ordering and breaks the distance ranking.

scenario: 用户想看最近 24 小时跑步距离榜，不能简单用一个永久累计 totalDistance score 回答。
scenario_en: A user wants a running-distance leaderboard for the last 24 hours, so one permanent cumulative totalDistance score is not enough.
q: 一种可行的 Redis 建模是什么？
q_en: What Redis model can support a time-window leaderboard?
options: 只用一个永久累计、从不重置清零的 global totalDistance 字段
把所有活动数据删除之后，再重新建一张空表
按 timestamp 存 activityId，再用 hash 聚合距离
让客户端自己算好排名结果后直接上传给服务端
options_en: Use only one permanent cumulative global totalDistance field that's never reset or zeroed
Delete all activity data and rebuild an empty table from scratch
Store activityId by timestamp, then aggregate distance from a hash
Have the client compute the ranking itself and upload the finished result directly to the server
why: 先用 timestamp sorted set 圈出时间范围内的活动，再用 hash 取出用户和距离聚合，可配短 TTL 缓存结果。
why_en: First narrow activities by a timestamp sorted set, then aggregate userId and distance from a hash, optionally caching the result briefly.
whenOtherWins: 固定窗口如 daily/weekly 可预维护独立 sorted sets，避免查询时聚合。
tradeoff: 查询灵活性 vs 聚合计算开销

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 的字段-值映射结构，适合存一个对象的多个属性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Redis hash maps field names to values, good for storing multiple attributes of one object.

optionExplanations: 永久累计只有一个总数，没法回答"最近 24 小时"这种带时间窗口的问题，窗口信息从一开始就没被保留。
删库重建会把所有历史活动数据一起清空，这是破坏性操作，不是一种查询建模方式。
拿一个按时间戳排序的集合圈出窗口内的 activityId，再从 hash 里取对应的用户和距离做聚合，换个窗口重算一次就行。
客户端上传的排名结果无法验证也不可审计，任何用户都能伪造一个对自己有利的名次。
optionExplanations_en: A single permanent running total can't answer a windowed question like 'last 24 hours' — the window information was never kept in the first place.
Deleting and rebuilding wipes out all historical activity data together; that is a destructive operation, not a query modeling strategy.
Take a timestamp-ordered set to narrow down the activityIds inside the window, then pull each one's user and distance from a hash to aggregate — recompute it for any window you need.
A ranking uploaded by the client can't be verified or audited, so any user could fabricate a ranking that favors themselves.

scenario: 排行榜要按地区/时间/运动类型多维过滤，Redis ZSET 扛排名查询，明细仍在主库。
scenario_en: The leaderboard filters by region, time window, and activity type; a Redis sorted set serves the ranking while details stay in the primary database.
q: Redis 排行榜方案需要注意哪些代价？（多选）
q_en: What costs must a Redis leaderboard design account for? (Choose all that apply)
options: 它自动替代所有活动明细存储
Redis 与主数据库的一致性/重试
内存随过滤维度和成员数增长
冷门组合不宜全部预物化
options_en: It automatically replaces all activity detail storage
Consistency and retries between Redis and the primary database
Memory grows with filter dimensions and member count
Rare filter combinations should not all be pre-materialized
why: Redis 排行榜是加速排名的派生视图，仍要处理同步失败重试和内存膨胀，不能替代活动明细数据库。
why_en: A Redis leaderboard is a derived view for speed, still needs consistency handling and memory planning, and cannot replace the activity database.
optionExplanations: 误解：Redis sorted set 只存 userId 和 score，看不到活动细节，替代不了活动明细数据库。
写 Redis 和写主数据库是两次独立操作，中间失败要靠重试或补偿逻辑，否则两边数据会对不上。
每多一个国家榜、时间窗口榜，就要多一个 sorted set，成员数和过滤维度一起增长内存占用。
冷门国家/时间组合访问很少，全部预先建好 key 会白白占内存，按需计算加短 TTL 更划算。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: a Redis sorted set only stores userId and score, with no activity detail — it cannot stand in for the activity database.
Writing to Redis and writing to the primary database are two separate operations; a failure between them needs retries or compensation or the two go out of sync.
Every extra country board or time-window board adds another sorted set, so memory grows with both member count and filter dimensions.
Rare country/time combinations get little traffic, so pre-building every key wastes memory — computing on demand with a short TTL pays off better.

q: 选择排行榜实现的决策链，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct decision chain for choosing a leaderboard implementation?
steps: 若要求快速实时 top-N，用 Redis sorted set 做派生视图
先识别全表 group by 每次请求不可扩展
若允许滞后，用周期性聚合表
为国家/时间范围等过滤控制预物化数量或按需缓存
why: 先排除请求时全量聚合，再按实时性选择预聚合或 Redis，并控制过滤维度爆炸。
why_en: Leaderboard design starts by avoiding request-time full aggregation, then chooses batch or Redis based on freshness needs and controls filter explosion.
tradeoff: 读取新鲜度 vs 计算和存储成本
diagram:
flowchart TD
  N[Naive aggregate too slow]
  B[Periodic batch view]
  R[Redis sorted set]
  K[Keys by country time]
  N --> B --> R --> K

scenario: 用户在无信号山路跑步，服务端一段时间完全不可达，但这次活动数据绝不能丢。
scenario_en: A user runs a mountain trail with no signal and the backend is unreachable for a while, yet this activity data must not be lost.
q: 为什么 Strava 活动记录通常选择 availability 大于 consistency？
q_en: Why does Strava-style activity recording usually favor availability over consistency?
options: 所有活动数据都必须做到实时强一致
好友列表的重要性天生高于路线数据
继续本地记录比立刻服务器一致更重要
这个数据库完全不支持任何一致性
options_en: All activity data must be strongly consistent in real time
Friend lists are inherently more important than route data
Continuing to record locally matters more than immediate server consistency
This database supports no consistency guarantees at all
why: 用户在弱网/无网时不能因为服务端不可达就丢运动数据，本地记录为准，网络恢复后再同步。
why_en: Users should not lose workout data just because the server is unreachable, so local recording wins and syncs once the network returns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统在请求到来时仍能返回响应的能力，即使数据可能不是最新的。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Availability is a system's ability to keep responding to requests even if the data might be slightly stale.

termDefinitions.meaning: 所有节点或客户端在同一时间看到相同的数据版本。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistency means every node or client sees the same version of the data at the same time.

optionExplanations: 误解：这正是本题要放弃的假设——强制实时强一致会让离线场景直接失败。
误解：好友列表和路线数据的重要性排序，不是这道题里 availability 优先于 consistency 的取舍依据。
服务端不可达时不能让运动记录停下来，本地先记，网络恢复后再同步，availability 因此排在前面。
误解：数据库本身仍能支持一致性，只是这个场景主动选择不优先要它，能力和取舍是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Misconception: this is exactly the assumption the design gives up — forcing real-time strong consistency would break the offline scenario.
Misconception: ranking friend-list importance against route data is not what drives the availability-over-consistency choice here.
Tracking cannot stop just because the server is unreachable, so local recording wins first and syncs once the network returns, putting availability ahead.
Misconception: the database can still support consistency; this scenario just chooses not to prioritize it — capability and trade-off are different things.

scenario: 同一活动本地有未上传 chunks，后台同步可能重试，服务端需要避免重复写入路线片段。
scenario_en: The same activity has local chunks that are not uploaded yet, background sync may retry, and the server must avoid duplicate route writes.
q: 上传协议应加入什么机制？
q_en: What mechanism should the upload protocol add for safe retries?
options: 每次网络重试都重新创建一个全新的 Activity 记录
用 activityId 加 chunk 序列号去重
出现冲突时让用户手动合并 JSON 数据
完全不保存任何 chunk 相关的元数据
options_en: Create a brand-new Activity record on every network retry
Deduplicate using activityId plus a chunk sequence number
Have the user manually merge JSON data when conflicts occur
Don't store any chunk-related metadata at all
why: 分块同步必须能幂等重试，否则网络抖动会造成重复的 route points 或重复的活动。
why_en: Chunked sync must tolerate idempotent retries, or network glitches will duplicate route points or entire activities.
whenOtherWins: 一次性小 payload 上传可只用 activityId 幂等；长活动分块更需要 chunk-level 去重。
tradeoff: 幂等去重的可靠性 vs 额外的元数据存储

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端在重试请求时附带的唯一标识，让服务端识别并丢弃重复请求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An idempotency key is a unique identifier attached to a retried request so the server can discard duplicates.

optionExplanations: 每次重试都新建活动等于把网络抖动的次数变成重复活动的数量，同一次运动会变出好几条记录。
服务端拿 (activityId, chunkSeq) 当唯一键，重复到达的同一个 chunk 会被直接识别并丢弃，不产生重复数据。
同步协议应该对用户透明，让用户手动合并 JSON 既不现实也违背离线优先想减少用户负担的初衷。
没有元数据服务端就没法判断这个 chunk 之前是否已经处理过，重试和去重都无从谈起。
optionExplanations_en: Creating a new Activity on every retry turns each network hiccup into another duplicate activity record for the same workout.
The server treats (activityId, chunkSeq) as a unique key, so a chunk that arrives again gets recognized and dropped instead of duplicated.
The sync protocol should stay invisible to the user; asking them to manually merge JSON isn't realistic and defeats offline-first's goal of reducing user burden.
Without metadata the server has no way to tell whether a chunk was already processed, so retries cannot be deduplicated at all.

scenario: 初始高层设计每个新 GPS 坐标都 POST /activities/:id/routes 到服务端并更新 distance。
scenario_en: The initial high-level design POSTs every new GPS coordinate to /activities/:id/routes and updates distance on the server.
q: 离线优先深挖后，这个 endpoint 的角色应如何变化？
q_en: After the offline-first deep dive, how should this route endpoint's role change?
options: 继续要求每个坐标点都实时在线同步，否则活动无效
彻底删除所有的路线记录功能
从实时路径变成同步补传路径，可批量接受坐标
这个接口只留给好友点赞功能使用
options_en: Still require every coordinate point to sync online in real time or the activity is invalid
Delete all route-recording functionality entirely
It shifts from a live required path to a batch sync/backfill path
Reserve this endpoint only for friend likes
why: 本地记录后，服务端的 route 写入主要发生在活动完成或后台同步时，不再阻塞运动中的体验。
why_en: After local recording, server-side route writes mainly happen on completion or background sync, no longer blocking the live workout.
whenOtherWins: 如果开启好友实时跟随，仍会有周期性 route update，但它服务分享而非本人本地统计。
tradeoff: 运动中体验不受网络影响 vs 服务端数据的实时性
optionExplanations: 把在线同步当成活动生效的前提，等于把离线优先深挖的结论又推翻了回去。
路线记录功能本身没变，变的只是它什么时候被调用——完成后调用，不是删掉。
接口保留但不再是实时必经路径，客户端完成后一次性或分块把攒下的坐标批量提交。
点赞是社交互动的一个独立功能，跟路线数据写入是两条完全不相关的接口路径。
optionExplanations_en: Treating online sync as a prerequisite for a valid activity undoes the whole conclusion the offline-first deep dive just reached.
The route-recording feature itself has not changed — what changes is when it gets called, on completion, not deleted.
The endpoint stays, but it's no longer a required live path; the client submits the accumulated coordinates in one batch or chunks after completion.
Likes are a separate social-interaction feature, an entirely unrelated endpoint path from writing route data.

scenario: 45 分钟 Strava 面试收尾，面试官在找主动给出的取舍信号，而不是功能罗列。
scenario_en: Wrapping up a 45-minute Strava interview, the interviewer wants proactively stated tradeoffs, not a feature list.
q: Strava 题高质量答案通常应主动指出哪些判断？（多选）
q_en: Which judgments should a strong Strava system-design answer proactively mention? (Choose all that apply)
options: 客户端本地记录是核心设计点
每几秒同步 GPS 到服务端不是本人活动统计的必要条件
所有实时需求都必须 WebSocket
存储规模大但可用分片和冷热分层管理
options_en: Client-side local recording is the core design point
Syncing GPS every few seconds is not required for the athlete's own stats
All realtime requirements must use WebSocket
Storage is large but manageable with sharding and tiering
why: 这题的高信号在于利用客户端能力、避免不必要的服务端实时化，并用量级估算指导存储设计。
why_en: Strong answers lean on client capability, avoid unnecessary server-side realtime work, and use scale estimates to guide storage design.
optionExplanations: 主动点出客户端承担实时记录职责，是这题区别于纯后端设计题的最大信号。
主动澄清"本人看到的数据不用等服务器"，说明理解了离线优先的真正含义，不是漏掉了同步。
误解：这题里好友端用几秒延迟的轮询就够，逢实时就上 WebSocket 是过度设计的信号。
主动用年增量和存储量级推出分片和冷热分层的判断，展示了量化思维而不是直觉判断。
optionExplanations_en: Proactively pointing out that the client owns live tracking is the biggest signal distinguishing this from a pure backend design question.
Proactively clarifying that the athlete's own view doesn't wait on the server shows real understanding of offline-first, not a missed requirement.
Misconception: friends here are fine with a few-seconds-delay poll; reaching for WebSocket every time realtime comes up is a sign of over-engineering.
Proactively using yearly growth and storage-volume math to derive sharding and tiering shows quantitative reasoning instead of gut instinct.

q: 普通离线优先活动的端到端主路径，正确顺序是什么？
q_en: What is the correct end-to-end path for a normal offline-first activity?
steps: 用户完成后，客户端批量/分块上传活动和 route
用户点击 start，服务端创建 Activity，客户端开始本地记录
服务端保存完成活动，好友/自己列表通过分页 GET 读取摘要
运动中 GPS 点本地 buffer、计算距离和时间，并周期性持久化
why: 主路径是先创建活动，然后运动中由客户端负责实时记录和耐久性，完成后同步服务端并进入读取列表。
why_en: The main path creates an activity, tracks and persists locally during the workout, uploads after completion, and serves completed views from the backend.
tradeoff: 客户端承担实时记录 vs 服务端只处理持久化和读取
diagram:
flowchart TD
  S[Start activity]
  T[Track locally]
  P[Persist local route]
  U[Upload on completion]
  V[View in feeds]
  S --> T --> P --> U --> V

scenario: 面试时间有限，需求只要求记录、运动中查看数据、查看自己和好友活动。
scenario_en: Interview time is limited, and the requirements only ask for recording, in-workout stats, and viewing your own and friends' activities.
q: 最应该避免过早深挖的内容是什么？
q_en: What should you avoid digging into too early?
options: 完全无网络环境下的离线活动记录与本地统计功能
活动路线的存储空间估算和分片
活动状态变更的时间日志建模
认证、好友管理、点赞评论和 GDPR
options_en: Offline activity recording and local stats in a fully network-free environment
Storage estimation and sharding for activity routes
Time-log modeling for activity state changes
Authentication, friend management, likes/comments, and GDPR
why: 认证、好友管理、点赞评论和合规都被题目划为范围外，深挖会挤占离线、本地统计和存储这些核心非功能需求的时间。
